dataset: NASA Artemis II Orion ephemeris (as published)
description: Orion's path on Artemis II, the first crewed flight around the Moon since 1972, from separation from the upper stage to entry interface. Positions are in the Earth-Moon rotating frame (x towards the Moon, z along the normal of the Moon's orbit), in km.
sourceLabel: NASA, Track NASA's Artemis II Mission in Real Time (Artemis II Ephemeris ZIP)
moonModel: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms ch. 47 (truncated), computed in data-prep/build_artemis2.py
